Apprends-les par paires : responsible for, increase in, comply with, depend on, familiar with, demand for, consist of. units.d: Écouter un dialogue ou une annonce, répondre aux questions
units.tip: Lis les questions AVANT l'écoute : tu sauras quoi chercher (qui, où, pourquoi, que va-t-il faire ensuite ?). Les mots entendus tels quels dans une réponse sont souvent un piège.

d: M
Hi, I'm calling about the apartment you advertised. Is it still available?
W
Yes, it is. Would you like to come and see it this week?
M
That would be great. Is Thursday afternoon possible?
W
Thursday works. Let's say four o'clock, and please bring a copy of your ID.
q: Il appelle « about the apartment you advertised ».
What does the woman ask the man to bring?
« a copy of your ID » = une pièce d'identité. La bonne réponse reformule souvent le texte.

d: W
Did you finish the sales report for the board meeting?
M
Almost. I'm still waiting for the figures from the Lyon branch.
W
The meeting was moved up to tomorrow morning, so we need them today.
M
Then I'll call the branch manager right away.
q: What problem does the man mention?
« still waiting for the figures » = des chiffres manquent.
What will the man probably do next?
Question « next » : la réponse est dans la dernière réplique.

d: N

Attention passengers. Flight 208 to Seoul has been delayed due to bad weather. The new departure time is 6:45 p.m. Passengers may collect a meal voucher at the service desk near gate 12. We apologize for the inconvenience.
q: Why has the flight been delayed?
What can passengers get at the service desk?
« collect a meal voucher » = un bon repas.

d: N

Welcome to our monthly staff meeting. First, I'm happy to announce that our new online store exceeded its sales targets in its first quarter. Next week, the IT team will hold training sessions on the updated inventory software. Please sign up on the intranet by Friday.
q: What is the speaker happy to announce?
What are listeners asked to do by Friday?
« Please sign up on the intranet by Friday » pour les formations.

d: W
Excuse me, I bought this jacket here last week, but the zipper is already broken.
M

W
Yes, here it is. Can I exchange it for the same model?
M
Unfortunately, that model is sold out, but I can give you a full refund.
q: Where most likely are the speakers?
Veste, reçu, échange : un magasin de vêtements.
« I can give you a full refund ».

Should you have any questions, please contact us.
Tout le personnel est tenu d'assister à la formation.
All staff are required to attend the training.
All staff members are required to attend the training.
All employees are required to attend the training.

parts.t: Le bon mot dans le texte

units.d: look forward to + -ing, avoid/consider + -ing, plan/agree + to, recommend that + base verbale
units.tip: Après recommend, suggest, insist, require, it is essential + that, le verbe est à la base verbale (subjonctif) : We recommend that he attend. Certains verbes appellent -ing (avoid, consider, look forward to), d'autres to + verbe (plan, agree, decide).
p: Nous avons hâte de travailler avec vous.
We look forward to working with you.
We are looking forward to working with you.
We're looking forward to working with you.
Je vous recommande de réserver à l'avance.
I recommend that you book in advance.
I recommend booking in advance.
I recommend that you book ahead.
Il a décidé de démissionner.
He decided to resign.
He has decided to resign.
He's decided to resign.
Évitez d'utiliser votre téléphone en réunion.
Avoid using your phone in meetings.
Avoid using your phone during meetings.
c: We look forward to ___ you at the conference.
« look forward to » + -ing (to est une préposition).
The manager suggested that he ___ the report by Monday.
suggest that + base verbale (subjonctif) : that he submit.
Please avoid ___ personal calls during work hours.
The company plans ___ a new branch in Lyon.
It is essential that every employee ___ the safety rules.
It is essential that + base verbale.
Would you consider ___ the meeting to Thursday?
The client insisted that the delivery ___ on time.
She is used to ___ long hours.
be used to + -ing = être habitué à.
He used ___ in Seoul before joining us.
We stopped ___ from that supplier last year.
Remember ___ the door when you leave.
remember + to + verbe = penser à faire.
l: Have you decided to accept the offer?
Why did you stop using that software?
Do you mind waiting a few minutes?

parts.t: Le subjonctif après suggest et insist

units.d: despite/although, due to, whose/whom/where, every/few/little, unless
units.tip: Despite / in spite of / due to / because of + nom ; although / even though / because / while + proposition (sujet + verbe). Each / every + singulier ; few / many + pluriel ; little / much + indénombrable.
p: Malgré le retard, le client est satisfait.
Despite the delay, the client is satisfied.
In spite of the delay, the client is satisfied.
Despite the delay, the customer is satisfied.
Bien que le prix soit élevé, nous l'achèterons.
Although the price is high, we will buy it.
Even though the price is high, we will buy it.
Although the price is high, we'll buy it.
Chaque employé a reçu une prime.
Every employee received a bonus.
Each employee received a bonus.
Every employee got a bonus.
Le fournisseur dont nous parlions a appelé.
The supplier we were talking about called.
The supplier that we were talking about called.
The supplier who we were talking about called.
c: ___ its high price, the new model is selling well.
Despite + groupe nominal (its high price). Although / even though seraient suivis d'un sujet et d'un verbe.
___ it rained heavily, the event was a success.
The flight was cancelled ___ the storm.
Devant un nom : due to / because of.
The candidate ___ résumé impressed us will be called today.
The supplier ___ we met last week has sent a quote.
Complément représentant une personne : whom (ou who / that).
This is the office ___ I started my career.
We have very ___ time before the deadline.
applicants est dénombrable pluriel : a few.
___ the manager nor her assistant was available.
The new system is faster; ___, it is cheaper.
You won't get a refund ___ you keep the receipt.
l: Is there enough paper for the printer?
Can we finish today, or should we wait?

units.d: Situation, problème, prochaine étape, questions d'intention
units.tip: Lis les 3 questions AVANT l'écoute pour savoir quoi chercher. Les réponses reformulent ce qui est dit (« running late » → « delayed »). Les questions « Why does the man say… ? » portent sur l'intention, pas sur le sens littéral.

d: W
Hi Jake, did you get a chance to look at the new floor plan for the office?
M
I did. I like the open space, but I'm worried it'll be too noisy for the sales team. They're on the phone all day.
W
Good point. What if we set up a few small meeting rooms they could use for calls?
M
That would help. I'll ask the architect how much it would add to the budget.
q: « the new floor plan for the office » = l'aménagement des bureaux.
What is the man concerned about?
« I'm worried it'll be too noisy ».
What will the man do next?

d: M
Thanks for coming, Maria and Lisa. The client wants the brochure finished by Thursday instead of next week.
W
Thursday? That's only two days away. The photos haven't even been approved yet.
W
I can call the client this afternoon and get the approval. Then the design team could finish it tomorrow.
M
Great, Lisa. And I'll let the printer know we need a rush order.
q: What problem does the man mention?
A deadline has been moved up
Le client veut la brochure jeudi au lieu de la semaine prochaine.
What has not been done yet?
The photos have not been approved
The budget has not been approved
The price has not been agreed on
The printer has not been chosen
« The photos haven't even been approved yet ».

d: M
Excuse me, I'd like to return this coffee maker. It stopped working after two days.
W
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt?
M
I'm afraid I threw it away.
W
Well, if you paid by card, I can find the purchase in our system.
q: Where most likely are the speakers?
Il rapporte une cafetière achetée en magasin.
Why does the man say, « I'm afraid I threw it away »?
To explain that he cannot show the receipt
To ask for a new bag
Il répond à la demande de ticket : il ne l'a plus.
What does the woman offer to do?
« I can find the purchase in our system ».

d: W
Hi, this is Ana from Delta Logistics. Your shipment is being held at the port because some customs documents are missing.
M
Oh no. Which documents do you need?
W
The certificate of origin. If you e-mail it today, the goods should be released by Friday.
M
I'll send it within the hour. Thanks for letting me know.
q: La marchandise est bloquée au port.
When should the goods be released?

p: Je suis désolé, je vais être en retard.
I'm sorry, I'm going to be late.
Sorry, I'm running late.
I'm sorry, I'll be late.
I'm sorry, I'm running late.
Pouvez-vous m'envoyer le document aujourd'hui ?
Can you send me the document today?
Could you send me the document today?
Could you e-mail me the document today?
Je vais en parler à mon responsable.
I'll talk to my manager about it.
I will talk to my manager about it.
I'll discuss it with my manager.
c: The deadline has been moved ___ to Thursday.
move up a deadline = avancer une date.
I'm ___ late because of the traffic.
I'm running late = je suis en retard.
Could you ___ me know when the goods arrive?
I'd like a ___ for this coffee maker; it stopped working.
The shipment is being held ___ customs.
be held at customs = être retenu à la douane.
l: When can you deliver the order?
By the end of the week.
Should I call the supplier or e-mail them?

units.d: Annonce d'aéroport, message vocal, visite guidée, publicité
units.tip: Part 4 = un seul locuteur : annonce, message vocal, publicité, visite guidée, bulletin. Les premières phrases donnent le contexte (qui parle, où, pourquoi) ; note les chiffres (heures, portes, prix, dates).

d: N

Attention, passengers on Flight 208 to Toronto. Due to a mechanical problem, your departure gate has changed from gate 12 to gate 31. Boarding will now begin at 4:45. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.
q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?

d: N

Hello, this is Karen Wu from Bright Dental Clinic, calling for Mr. Thomas. This is a reminder of your appointment tomorrow at ten a.m. Please arrive fifteen minutes early to fill out some forms. If you need to reschedule, call us back before five o'clock today.
q: To remind the listener of an appointment
« This is a reminder of your appointment ».
What is the listener asked to do?
What should the listener do to reschedule?
« call us back before five o'clock today ».

d: N

Welcome to the Harbor Chocolate Factory. On today's tour, we'll first see how the cocoa beans are roasted, and then you'll watch our chocolatiers at work. Please note that photography is not allowed in the production area. At the end of the tour, everyone will receive a free sample in our gift shop.
q: Who most likely is the speaker?
Elle accueille le groupe et présente la visite.
What are the listeners asked not to do?
What will the listeners receive at the end?

d: N

Are you tired of long lines at the bank? With the new GreenPay app, you can transfer money, pay bills, and check your balance in seconds. Download it before the end of the month and get your first three months free. GreenPay: banking made simple.
q: What problem does the speaker mention?
« tired of long lines at the bank ».
« get your first three months free ».

p: Le vol a été retardé en raison d'un problème technique.
The flight has been delayed due to a technical problem.
The flight was delayed due to a technical problem.
The flight has been delayed because of a technical problem.
The flight was delayed because of a technical problem.
Merci de me rappeler avant 17 heures.
Please call me back before 5 p.m.
Please call me back before five p.m.
Please call me back before five o'clock.
Les photos ne sont pas autorisées.
Photography is not allowed.
Photos are not allowed.
Taking pictures is not allowed.
c: Please call us back ___ 5 p.m. today.
Visitors are not ___ to take photos inside the factory.
be allowed to = être autorisé à (passif).
l: Did anyone call while I was out?
Can I take photos in here?
How do I download the app?

units.t: Part 5 : modaux, discours indirect & questions indirectes
units.d: must have / can't have, don't need to, had better, told us / said that, asked whether, Do you know where… is?
units.tip: Déduction sur le passé : must have + participe (sûrement), can't have + participe (impossible). Discours indirect : tell + personne (told us), say sans personne (said that) ; les temps reculent (will → would, is → was). Question indirecte : l'ordre redevient sujet + verbe (Do you know where the room is?).
p: Il a dû partir tôt.
He must have left early.
He must've left early.
Pourriez-vous me dire où se trouve la salle de réunion ?
Could you tell me where the meeting room is?
Can you tell me where the meeting room is?
Could you tell me where the conference room is?
Elle nous a dit que la réunion était annulée.
She told us that the meeting was canceled.
She told us the meeting was canceled.
She told us that the meeting had been canceled.
She told us the meeting had been canceled.
She told us that the meeting was cancelled.
She told us the meeting was cancelled.
Tu n'as pas besoin d'apporter ton ordinateur.
You don't need to bring your laptop.
You don't have to bring your laptop.
You needn't bring your laptop.
You don't need to bring your computer.
You don't have to bring your computer.
c: Mr. Lee ___ have left already; his coat is still here.
can't have + participe = c'est impossible (déduction sur le passé).
The lights are off, so everyone ___ have gone home.
must have + participe = c'est sûrement ce qui s'est passé.
You ___ bring your laptop; we will provide one.
Absence d'obligation : don't need to / don't have to (mustn't = interdiction).
We ___ leave now if we want to catch the train.
had better + base verbale = il vaudrait mieux.
She told ___ that the meeting had been canceled.
tell + personne directement (told us), sans « to ».
He said ___ the budget would be approved.
say n'est pas suivi directement de la personne : said that…
The client asked ___ the order had been shipped.
Question fermée rapportée : ask whether / if.
Question indirecte : sujet + verbe, sans inversion.
Question indirecte : pas d'auxiliaire do, ordre sujet + verbe.
She said she ___ the report the next day.
Discours rapporté au passé : will → would.
You ___ have told me earlier; I could have helped.
should have + participe = reproche (tu aurais dû).
l: Do you know when the shipment will arrive?
Should I call the client back today?
Yes, she said it was urgent.
What did the manager say about the budget?
That it would be approved next week.
Can you tell me where the printer is?

units.t: Part 5 : so/such, too/enough, used to & verbes + -ing/to
units.d: such a… that, so… that, too + adj + to, adj + enough, used to / be used to, remember to / remember -ing, would rather, the more… the better, twice as… as
units.tip: so + adjectif (so long), such + nom (such a long meeting). too + adjectif + to (trop… pour), adjectif + enough (assez). used to + base verbale = habitude passée ; be/get used to + -ing = être/s'habituer à. remember TO do (ne pas oublier) ≠ remember DOING (se souvenir).
p: C'était une si bonne présentation que tout le monde a applaudi.
It was such a good presentation that everyone applauded.
The presentation was so good that everyone applauded.
Je préférerais travailler de chez moi demain.
I would rather work from home tomorrow.
I'd rather work from home tomorrow.
I would prefer to work from home tomorrow.
I'd prefer to work from home tomorrow.
Elle avait l'habitude de travailler à Séoul.
She used to work in Seoul.
Je ne suis pas habituée à me lever tôt.
I'm not used to getting up early.
I am not used to getting up early.
I'm not used to waking up early.
I am not used to waking up early.
c: It was ___ a successful event that we will repeat it next year.
The presentation was ___ long that some people left.
The room is not big ___ for fifty people.
The box is ___ heavy to lift alone.
She ___ work in Seoul before moving to Paris.
used to + base verbale = habitude passée, terminée.
I'm not used to ___ so early.
be used to + -ing (to est ici une préposition).
Please remember ___ the door when you leave.
remember to do = penser à faire (action à venir).
I remember ___ him at last year's conference.
remember doing = se souvenir d'avoir fait.
would rather + base verbale, sans to.
The more you practice, ___ you become.
The new model is twice ___ the old one.
l: Is the room big enough for the workshop?
Would you rather meet on Monday or Tuesday?
Didn't you use to work in sales?
Why was the event so popular?
It was very crowded at the door.

units.d: rise / raise, increase by, peak, level off, fluctuate, double, steady, quarter, revenue
units.tip: rise (intransitif : les ventes montent) ≠ raise (transitif : on augmente les prix). La préposition change le sens : rose BY 12% (de 12 points), rose TO 12% (jusqu'à 12 %). Ces mots reviennent dans les graphiques des Parts 3-4 et dans les rapports de la Part 7.
p: Les ventes ont augmenté de 12 %.
Sales increased by 12%.
Sales rose by 12%.
Sales went up by 12%.
Sales increased by 12 percent.
Sales rose by 12 percent.
Les bénéfices ont atteint un pic en décembre.
Profits peaked in December.
Profits reached a peak in December.
La demande s'est stabilisée.
Demand has leveled off.
Demand has levelled off.
Demand has stabilized.
Demand has stabilised.
Le chiffre d'affaires a doublé en deux ans.
Revenue has doubled in two years.
Revenue doubled in two years.
Sales have doubled in two years.
c: Sales rose ___ 12% in the third quarter.
by = de (l'écart) ; to = jusqu'à (le niveau atteint).
Profits reached a ___ in December before falling.
reach a peak = atteindre un sommet.
After months of growth, demand has leveled ___.
There was a slight ___ in prices last month.
The number of visitors ___ dramatically after the ad campaign.
Intransitif (pas de complément) : increase ou rise, jamais raise.
The company ___ its prices last year.
Revenue has ___ from $2 million to $4 million.
Prices have ___ throughout the year, going up and down.
fluctuate = varier dans les deux sens.
Sales of tablets remained ___ at 3,000 units.
The figures are ___ estimated, not final.
Un adverbe modifie le participe estimated.
l: How did sales do last quarter?
They rose by about ten percent.
Why did profits drop in March?
Our main supplier raised its prices.
In the first week of March.
Has the number of subscribers leveled off?
The level is on the third floor.
At the top of the mountain.

units.d: plant, assembly line, maintenance, inspection, warranty, recall, shortage, authorized personnel only
units.tip: Les panneaux et consignes (Part 7) utilisent souvent le passif et des formules figées : « Authorized personnel only », « must be worn at all times », « Employees are required to… ». warranty = garantie d'un produit ; recall = rappel d'un produit défectueux.
p: Accès réservé au personnel autorisé.
Authorized personnel only.
Authorised personnel only.
Access restricted to authorized personnel.
Only authorized personnel may enter.
Le produit est garanti deux ans.
The product has a two-year warranty.
The product comes with a two-year warranty.
The product is under warranty for two years.
The product is guaranteed for two years.
La chaîne de montage sera arrêtée pour maintenance.
The assembly line will be shut down for maintenance.
The assembly line will be stopped for maintenance.
Les employés doivent porter leur badge.
Employees must wear their badges.
Employees are required to wear their badges.
Employees have to wear their badges.
c: Only ___ personnel may enter this area.
Safety goggles must be worn ___ all times.
The product comes with a two-year ___.
The manufacturer has ___ thousands of defective heaters.
recall a product = rappeler un produit.
The assembly line will be shut down for routine ___.
Après l'adjectif routine : le nom maintenance.
All machinery must be ___ before each shift.
Il faut le verbe conjugué : produces.
Employees are ___ to wear their badges.
be required to = être tenu de.
The shipment was delayed due to a ___ of raw materials.
a shortage of = une pénurie de.
l: When will the assembly line be running again?
Is this heater still under warranty?
Who should I report the problem to?
It was reported in the news.

units.d: Paronymes et collocations des hauts scores
units.tip: Pièges classiques : expand / expend, extensive / expensive, renew / renovate. Le TOEIC adore les mots qui se ressemblent.
c: The company plans to ___ its operations into Asia next year.
expand into = s'étendre sur un marché. expend = dépenser.
All visitors must ___ with the safety regulations.
The contract will be ___ for another two years.
On renouvelle (renew) un contrat ; on rénove (renovate) un bâtiment.
Keep all receipts so that you can be ___ for travel expenses.
Se faire rembourser des frais : be reimbursed.
The CEO's speech was ___ by the entire staff.
Candidates with ___ experience will be given priority.
extensive experience = une solide expérience. expensive = cher.
The merger is ___ to be finalized by the end of the year.
l: Why don't we hire a temporary worker?
When will the renovations be completed?
Could you review my proposal this afternoon?
Yes, I viewed it last year.
p: Nous devons réduire nos coûts de production.
We need to reduce our production costs.
We have to reduce our production costs.
We must reduce our production costs.
We need to cut our production costs.
La fusion devrait être finalisée en décembre.
The merger is expected to be finalized in December.
The merger should be finalized in December.
The merger is expected to be finalised in December.
Tous les visiteurs doivent se conformer aux règles de sécurité.
All visitors must comply with the safety rules.
All visitors must comply with safety rules.
All visitors must comply with the safety regulations.

units.d: E-mails, annonces, offres d'emploi, messages
units.tip: Lis d'abord la question, puis cherche le passage précis. Pour « NOT mentioned », élimine les trois réponses que tu retrouves dans le texte.

rd.x:
To: All staff
From: Facilities Department
Subject: Parking lot maintenance

Please note that the east parking lot will be closed from Monday, March 3, to Wednesday, March 5, for repainting. During this period, employees may park in the visitor lot on Green Street. Shuttle buses will run every 15 minutes between the visitor lot and the main entrance. We apologize for any inconvenience.
q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
To introduce a new shuttle company
To ask staff to repaint the lot
Le parking sera fermé trois jours : fermeture temporaire.
How often will the shuttle buses run?

rd.x: Brightline Hotels is seeking a Front Desk Supervisor for its downtown location. Responsibilities include training new staff, handling guest complaints, and preparing weekly schedules. Candidates must have at least three years of experience in hospitality. Fluency in a second language is a plus. To apply, send your résumé by April 30.
q: What is NOT mentioned as a responsibility?
Les trois autres tâches sont citées ; la commande de fournitures n'apparaît pas.
What is required for the position?
« must have » = obligatoire. La langue étrangère est seulement « a plus ».

rd.x:
Riverside Library — Summer Reading Program
Children aged 6 to 12 can join our free summer reading program starting June 15. Participants who read ten books by August 31 will receive a certificate and a free ticket to the city aquarium. Registration is available online or at the information desk. Space is limited to 50 children.
q: What will participants receive for reading ten books?
A certificate and an aquarium ticket
« a certificate and a free ticket to the city aquarium ».
What is suggested about the program?
The number of places is limited

rd.x:
Mina Park (9:12 A.M.): Hi Tom, the client from Osaka just landed. Can you pick him up at the airport?
Tom Reyes (9:14 A.M.): I'm in a meeting until 10. Could Julia go instead?
Mina Park (9:15 A.M.): She's off today. I'll call a taxi for him then.
Tom Reyes (9:16 A.M.): Good idea. I'll meet him at the office at 10:30.
q: Why can't Tom go to the airport?
At 9:15 A.M., what does Mina mean when she writes, "She's off today"?
« to be off » = être en congé / ne pas travailler.

c: The parking lot will be closed ___ Monday to Wednesday.
Fluency in a second language is a ___, but not required.
« is a plus » = est un atout.
Employees should park ___ the back entrance during the work.
near + nom = près de (préposition) ; nearly = presque.
Applicants must ___ their résumé by May 31.
Children ___ 6 to 12 can join the program.
aged 6 to 12 = âgés de 6 à 12 ans (participe passé).
Can you pick him up ___ the airport?
pick someone up at + lieu précis (at the airport).

units.d: Phrase manquante, connecteurs logiques, références (they, it)
units.tip: En Part 6, une question sur quatre demande d'insérer une phrase entière : relis la phrase d'avant et celle d'après. La bonne phrase reprend une idée précise (pronom, connecteur, référence) ; les autres sont souvent vraies mais hors sujet.
c: « Our office will be closed on Monday for the holiday. ___ We will reopen on Tuesday at 9 a.m. »
During this time, urgent requests can be sent to help@corp.com.
Our new office has a large parking lot.
Thank you for applying for the position.
The holiday party was a great success.
La phrase doit concerner la fermeture : que faire pendant ce temps.
« Thank you for your order #4521. ___ You will receive a tracking number by e-mail. »
Your package was shipped this morning.
Le numéro de suivi suit logiquement l'expédition.
« We are pleased to welcome Ms. Diaz as our new marketing director. ___ She will start on May 1. »
She has over fifteen years of experience in the field.
Please return your keys to reception.
On présente une nouvelle recrue : son expérience.
« The elevator in Building B will be inspected on Friday. ___ We apologize for any inconvenience. »
Please use the stairs or the elevator in Building A.
The inspection report was very positive.
La phrase propose une solution pendant l'inspection, avant les excuses.
Sales have doubled this year. ___, we will hire five new employees.
The new software is easy to use. ___, it is not compatible with older computers.
Please read the attached guidelines. ___ will help you prepare for the interview.
We have received your application. ___, the position has already been filled.
The conference was ___ attended, with over 500 participants.
Our records show that your payment is overdue. Please ___ it as soon as possible.
p: Par conséquent, nous recruterons cinq personnes.
Therefore, we will hire five people.
Therefore, we'll hire five people.
As a result, we will hire five people.
Malheureusement, le poste a déjà été pourvu.
Unfortunately, the position has already been filled.
Unfortunately, the job has already been filled.
Veuillez utiliser l'escalier.
Please use the stairs.
Please take the stairs.
l: Yes, we hired someone last week.
When will the elevator be inspected?
Did you get the tracking number?
The invoice went to the wrong address.

units.d: Messagerie, questions d'intention, croiser deux documents, insertion de phrase, NOT true
units.tip: Lis d'abord les questions, puis cherche les mots clés dans le texte. Dans les doubles documents, une réponse demande souvent de croiser deux infos. Pour les questions « NOT mentioned », élimine les trois infos présentes dans le texte.

rd.x:
Mia Lopez [10:02] Hi team, the client moved our call to 3 p.m. Can everyone still make it?
Raj Patel [10:04] I have a dentist appointment at 3:30. I can join for the first half hour.

Mia Lopez [10:06] Yes please, Tom. Raj, could you send me your notes before you leave?
Raj Patel [10:07] Sure, I'll e-mail them by noon.

To invite the team to lunch
« the client moved our call to 3 p.m. ».
At 10:04, what does Mr. Patel mean when he writes, « I can join for the first half hour »?
He will have to leave the call early
Rendez-vous à 15 h 30 : il partira au bout de 30 minutes.
What will Mr. Patel do by noon?

rd.x:

The center will close at 6 p.m. on weekends

Il s'entraîne le dimanche après 19 h ; le week-end, le centre fermera à 18 h.
How much does the plan Mr. Grant wants cost?
What does Mr. Grant ask about?
« Can I pay in two installments? ».

rd.x:
JOB OPENING — Customer Support Specialist (Remote)
NovaTech is looking for a friendly, organized person to answer customer questions by phone and chat. Requirements: at least two years of experience in customer service, fluent English, and basic computer skills. Knowledge of Spanish is a plus. Benefits include flexible hours and a yearly training budget. To apply, send your résumé and a short cover letter to jobs@novatech.com by March 15.

Le diplôme n'est jamais mentionné ; les trois autres sont exigés.

rd.x:
Dear Ms. Romano,
Thank you for staying at the Grand Lake Hotel last week. We are sorry to hear that the air conditioning in your room was not working properly. [1] As an apology, we have refunded one night of your stay to your credit card. [2] We have also asked our maintenance team to check every unit on your floor. [3] We hope to welcome you again soon.

David Moore, Guest Relations Manager

Il répond à un problème de climatisation qu'elle a signalé.
What has the hotel done for Ms. Romano?
In which position does this sentence best fit: « The refund should appear within five business days »?
La phrase parle du remboursement : juste après la phrase qui l'annonce, en [2].

Could you send me your notes before noon?

Opening hours will change.
Nous vous avons remboursé une nuit.

« is a plus » = est un atout.

Changer de créneau : move … to + nouvel horaire.

parts.t: Lis un avis et une offre d'emploi

units.d: will be + participe, must be submitted, interested/interesting, have something done, Should you…, Not only did…
units.tip: Si le sujet subit l'action, passif : be + participe passé. -ed décrit ce que ressent la personne (interested), -ing ce qui provoque le sentiment (interesting). Une phrase qui commence par Should, Had, Not only, Rarely ou Hardly inverse sujet et auxiliaire.
p: La nouvelle politique sera mise en place le mois prochain.
The new policy will be implemented next month.
The new policy will be put in place next month.
J'ai fait réparer ma voiture.
I had my car repaired.
I got my car repaired.
Si vous avez besoin d'aide, contactez-nous.
Should you need help, contact us.
Should you need help, please contact us.
If you need help, contact us.
If you need help, please contact us.
Should you need any help, please contact us.
If you need any help, please contact us.
Les résultats étaient décevants.
The results were disappointing.
c: La politique subit l'action : passif futur (will be + participe).
Employees ___ in the workshop should register online.
Ce que ressentent les employés : -ed (interested in).
The results of the survey were ___.
Ms. Lee had her car ___ at the dealership.
have + objet + participe passé = faire faire quelque chose par quelqu'un.
The manager had the intern ___ the files.
have + personne + base verbale = faire faire à quelqu'un.
___ you need further assistance, please contact our help desk.
Should you need… = If you need… (inversion très fréquente au TOEIC).
Not only ___ the team finish on time, but it also stayed under budget.
Not only en tête de phrase → inversion avec l'auxiliaire (did).
Rarely ___ such strong sales in the first quarter.
Rarely en tête → inversion : have we seen.
___ the report, Mr. Kim sent it to the board.
Having + participe = action terminée avant la suivante.
The documents ___ to the client yesterday contained an error.
Relative réduite : the documents (which were) sent.
Hardly ___ the meeting begun when the power went out.
Hardly … when + past perfect inversé : Hardly had the meeting begun.
l: Has the budget been approved yet?
Not yet, the board meets on Friday.
Who's going to be interviewed for the position?
Because of a storm at the port.
Should I have the printer repaired or replaced?
Let's get a quote for both first.

units.d: Look at the graphic : planning, liste de prix, plan d'étage, tableau des départs
units.tip: Avant l'écoute, lis le graphique et repère ce qui change d'une ligne à l'autre. La réponse n'est presque jamais citée telle quelle : on entend l'autre colonne (le nom de la session) et tu dois lire l'horaire ou le prix correspondant.
p: Ma présentation a été déplacée à cet après-midi.
My presentation has been moved to this afternoon.
My presentation was moved to this afternoon.
Quelle formule nous conviendrait le mieux ?
Which plan would suit us best?
Which plan would work best for us?
Le prochain train express part à 9 h 05.
The next express train leaves at 9:05.
The next express train departs at 9:05.
c: They ___ the two sessions because the speaker was late.
Video calls are only ___ with the Premium plan.
The Basic plan is ___ than the Premium plan.
Adjectif court au comparatif : cheap → cheaper than.
The cafeteria is located ___ the third floor.
on the third floor = au troisième étage.

Excuse me, my 8:15 express to Boston was canceled. What's the fastest way to get there?

The local train leaves earlier, but it stops at every station. You'll actually arrive sooner on the next express.

units.d: Annonce + e-mail + facture, avis + message + bon de livraison : croiser les trois documents
units.tip: Dans un triple document, au moins une question oblige à croiser deux textes (ex. : le nombre de personnes dans la facture et la règle de remise dans l'annonce). Lis d'abord les questions, puis repère dans quel document chercher. Les noms, dates et chiffres qui reviennent d'un document à l'autre sont la clé.
p: Merci de passer commande au moins 48 heures à l'avance.
Please place your order at least 48 hours in advance.
Please order at least 48 hours in advance.
Le monte-charge reste disponible pour les livraisons.
The freight elevator remains available for deliveries.
The freight elevator is still available for deliveries.
Six repas végétariens sont inclus.
Six vegetarian meals are included.
c: Orders must be placed at least 48 hours ___ advance.
Elevator A will be out ___ service on Monday.
freight elevator = monte-charge (nom employé comme adjectif).
Payment is due ___ 30 days of the invoice date.
within + durée = dans un délai de.
l: Has the invoice been sent to the client?
Which elevator is out of service today?
Did you order lunch for the training day?
